review:
Sweet Bonanza with a frozen Christmas look – same pay-anywhere tumble game. Matching candies anywhere pay and tumble away.

Four or more scatters give 10 free spins, where bombs worth up to 100x can land; they stay until the tumble sequence ends, then their combined value hits the win. Plays exactly like the original, just festive. 96.48% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
